result.summary: The main visual issue is a cropped or improperly scaled image at the bottom of the feed.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is heavily cropped/cut off at the bottom and sides, making it unclear what the content is or if it is a clickable element.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or aspect ratio of the card container to ensure the image and offer badge are fully visible within the layout.

issues.description: The 'See all' links are positioned slightly higher than the section titles they align with, potentially creating a visual imbalance.
issues.suggestion: Vertically align the 'See all' links with the baseline of the section titles for better consistency.
